description: This Java source file defines the ThingsSseRouteBuilder class, which creates and manages server-sent events (SSE) routes for '/things' and '/search' endpoints in an Eclipse Ditto Gateway. It handles authorization, streaming setup, event filtering, and enrichment for SSE connections.

classes.name: ThingsSseRouteBuilder
classes.description: This class builds Akka HTTP routes for handling Server Sent Events (SSE) for '/things' and '/search' endpoints, managing authorization, streaming, enrichment, and filtering of SSE data within Eclipse Ditto Gateway.

classes.name: NoOpSseAuthorizationEnforcer
classes.description: A dummy implementation of SseAuthorizationEnforcer that always grants authorization.

classes.name: NoOpSseConnectionSupervisor
classes.description: A dummy implementation of SseConnectionSupervisor that performs no supervision actions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of ThingsSseRouteBuilder with the provided streaming actor, config, and mediator.

methods.name: withAuthorizationEnforcer
methods.description: Sets a custom authorization enforcer for SSE routes.

methods.name: withEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets a custom event sniffer for debugging or logging SSE events.

methods.name: withSseConnectionSupervisor
methods.description: Sets a custom supervisor for SSE connections.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Sets a provider for enriching signals with additional data.

methods.name: withProxyActor
methods.description: Sets an optional proxy actor for '/search' route requests.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the complete route, handling '/things' and '/search' endpoints with appropriate authorization, parameters, and streaming logic.

methods.name: buildSearchSseRoute
methods.description: Builds the '/search/things' SSE route with search-specific parameters and execution pipeline.

methods.name: buildThingsSseRoute
methods.description: Builds the '/things' SSE route with filtering and enrichment capabilities.

methods.name: createSseRoute
methods.description: Creates the SSE route for '/things' with filtering, authorization, streaming, and enrichment logic.

methods.name: createSearchSseRoute
methods.description: Creates the SSE route for '/search/things', including search source setup and event streaming.

methods.name: postprocess
methods.description: Post-processes streamed JSON objects, performing enrichment, filtering, and converting to JsonObjects for SSE transmission.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Helper to parse namespace parameter string into list.

methods.name: getThingIds
methods.description: Helper to parse thing ID parameter string into list.

methods.name: getFieldSelector
methods.description: Helper to parse field selector string into JsonFieldSelector object.

methods.name: namespaceFromId
methods.description: Extracts namespace from a ThingEvent entity ID.

methods.name: newAcceptHeaderExtractor
methods.description: Creates a partial function to extract Accept headers that match text/event-stream media types.
